Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 chk_dup1 number :=0;
 chk_dup2 number :=0;
 ins_flg number :=0;
begin
 begin
 select description
 into :valid_notific_letters.donation_desc
 from valid_donation_types
 where donation_type=:valid_notific_letters.donation_type
 and trunc(sysdate) between trunc(eff_date) and 
 nvl(trunc(term_date),sysdate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('18035'); /* Invalid Donation Type */
 end;
 begin
-- chk_dup1 := 0;
 select count(*)
 into chk_dup1
 from valid_notific_letters
 where inter_code = :valid_notific_letters.inter_code
 and donation_type = :valid_notific_letters.donation_type;
-- and letter_id = :valid_notific_letters.donation_type;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when too_many_rows then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 if chk_dup1 > 0 then
 show_error('18132');
 return;
 end if;

 /*Check duplicate recs which have not yet got committed */
 check_insert_rg('RG_VNLETTR','C05C05',
 :valid_notific_letters.inter_code||','||
 :valid_notific_letters.donation_type||',',
 'C',chk_dup2);
 if chk_dup2 = 1 then
 show_error('18132');
 return;
 end if;

 check_insert_rg('RG_VNLETTR','C05C05',
 :valid_notific_letters.inter_code||','||
 :valid_notific_letters.donation_type||',',
 'U',ins_flg); 
 if ins_flg = 1 then
 show_error('18132');
-- show_error('9199');
 return;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM

declare

 chk_dup2 number :=0;

 select distinct 1
 into dummy
 from valid_letters
 where letter_code = :valid_notific_letters.letter_id
 and document_type = 'N'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl( term_date, sysdate+1 );
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('18123');
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*)
 into chk_dup1
 from valid_notific_letters
 where inter_code = :valid_notific_letters.inter_code
 and donation_type = :valid_notific_letters.donation_type
 and letter_id = :valid_notific_letters.letter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 if chk_dup1 > 0 then
 show_error('18188');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 /*Check duplicate recs which have not yet got committed */
 check_insert_rg('RG_VNLETR2','C05C05C10',
 :valid_notific_letters.inter_code||','||
 :valid_notific_letters.donation_type||','||
 :valid_notific_letters.letter_id||',',
 'C',chk_dup2);
 if chk_dup2 = 1 then
 show_error('18188');
 return;
 end if;

 check_insert_rg('RG_VNLETR2','C05C05C10',
 :valid_notific_letters.inter_code||','||
 :valid_notific_letters.donation_type||','||
 :valid_notific_letters.letter_id||',',
 'U',ins_flg); 
 if ins_flg = 1 then
 show_error('9199');
 return;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PROPERTIES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_properties (field_name1 IN varchar2, no_entry OUT number,
 r_chk OUT varchar2, f_chk OUT varchar2) IS
 F_required varchar2(1);
 f_double number; 
 F_func varchar2(1); 
begin
 
 select required, no_of_entries , function_check
 into f_required, f_double , f_func
 from find_donor_fields
 where program_name = :banner.prog_name and
 field_name = field_name1;
 if f_required = 'Y' then
 nullchk; check_package_failure;
 end if;
 no_entry := f_double;
 r_chk := F_required;
 F_chk := f_func;
 
exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('9206');
 check_package_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_NAVIGATION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE SET_NAVIGATION (F_NAME IN VARCHAR2,FLG IN VARCHAR2) IS
BEGIN
 IF FLG = 'T' THEN 
 set_item_property(F_NAME,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSE
 set_item_property(F_NAME,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_false);
 set_item_property(F_NAME,ENABLED,PROPERTY_false);
 END IF;
END;
